game: TEN@IND Week 8 2025, kickoff 2025-10-26 16:25 ET, Lucas Oil closed roof, IND -15.5, total 47.5

script.base: Colts are 15.5-point favorites with implied totals IND 31.5 / TEN 16.0 in a closed roof. Base script is IND ahead by two scores by halftime, Jonathan Taylor (54 carries, 283 rush yards in weeks 5-7) grinding the clock, and Tennessee abandoning the run so Tony Pollard (rush yards 67, 34, 18 across weeks 5-7) loses carries while TEN throws from behind into a 16-point team total.
script.flip1: Tennessee hangs within one score into the fourth, so IND keeps throwing to Warren, Pittman and Pierce, Taylor's clock-kill carries shrink toward the 94.5 line, and Pollard stays in a split run game long enough to threaten 60.5.
script.flip2: IND is up 21-plus by half and pulls Taylor for Giddens (L3 5 carries, 22 yards) and Abdullah. IND WR/TE yards stall. TEN is in pure dropback, which makes the Pollard rush under even safer unless a garbage-time chunk run hits.

injury_fallout: Known pre-game from the pack injury report, not final inactives: TEN WR Calvin Ridley Out (hamstring) and Bryce Oliver Out (knee) remove Ridley's weeks 5-7 line of 11 targets / 149 yards / 182 air. Next men already on the field are Ayomanor (14/74/159), Okonkwo (13/94/59), Dike (12/95/154), Helm (13/85/93) and Jefferson (10/116/133). TEN G Blake Hance Out (shoulder) should cut rush efficiency and force quicker throws, but IND DE Samson Ebukam Out (knee) and DE Tyquan Lewis Out (groin) remove two edge rushers and IND blitzes only 27%, so the pressure bump is partly offset. TEN DT Jeffery Simmons Out (hamstring) weakens a run defense already at 4.89 YPC and 26 runs of 10+, which feeds Taylor. IND CB Jaylon Jones Out (hamstring) is an uncharted hole for TEN receivers. TEN S Xavier Woods (ankle) and LB Arden Key (quad) are Questionable, not Out; if Woods sits, Pierce's deep shots (333 air yards in weeks 5-7) get easier. No snap-limit note in the pack.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost. IND led 28-3 at half, Taylor had 14 carries and 71 yards and sat, and Giddens mopped up, so 94.5 never had a chance. On the other side IND's backup front was soft, Pollard ripped one 35-yard run in the third and finished at 62, clearing 60.5 on a broken play rather than a workload. The Taylor counter is stronger than the Pollard counter, which is why Taylor is a lean and the slip is flagged rather than sized. A Woods inactive that turns this into a Pierce/Warren pass script would also kill Taylor without saving Pollard if the game stays close.
slip_story: One story only: favorite runs the clock. IND -15.5, Taylor rush over, Pollard rush under. Do not add IND WR overs (they need the pass-heavy flip) or a total under with same-game receiving overs. TEN WR overs from the Ridley vacuum need the trailing pass script and can correlate with Pollard under, but they are not on this slip. No TDs, no receptions, no passing yards.
